# 0nMCP — Universal AI API Orchestrator
> Stop building workflows. Start describing outcomes.

## What is 0nMCP?

0nMCP is the universal AI API orchestrator. **1,554 tools across 96 services in 22 categories**, plus 200+ pre-built automations. One `npm install 0nmcp`. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, Windsurf, and any MCP-compatible AI client.

**Current version**: v4.5.1 (BSL 1.1 license, final beta before v5.0 — May 1, 2026)
**npm package**: [0nmcp](https://www.npmjs.com/package/0nmcp)
**Vendor**: RocketOpp LLC
**Domains**: 0nmcp.com (marketing + community + 658 SEO pages) · 0ncore.com (customer portal)

## Three-Level Execution (Patent Pending #63/990,046)

- **Pipeline** — Sequential step-by-step workflows
- **Assembly Line** — Parallel processing with dependencies
- **Radial Burst** — One trigger fans out to multiple services simultaneously

## Core Modules

| Module | Tools | Description |
|--------|------:|-------------|
| Catalog | 1,280 | 96 services, 209 actions, 310 triggers |
| CRM | 245 | Full leadconnectorhq.com integration (contacts, calendars, opportunities, invoices, social, custom objects, payments) |
| Vault | 4 | AES-256-GCM credential encryption (machine-bound) |
| Vault Container | 8 | `.0nv` containers — Argon2id + multi-party escrow + Ed25519 signatures |
| Deed | 6 | Business deed transfer (assets + workflows) |
| Engine | 6 | Application builder, scheduler, plugin system |
| App | 5 | Web app surfaces |

## The .0n Standard

Universal configuration format for AI orchestration. Just as `.git` standardized version control and `.env` standardized environment configuration, `.0n` is the open standard for AI workflows, vaults, snapshots, deeds, and capabilities.

- **9 file types**: connection, workflow, snapshot, vault, deed, app, capability, brain, config
- **7-layer semantic knowledge architecture**
- npm: [0n-spec v2.0.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/0n-spec) (CC-BY-4.0)

## Site Architecture

0nmcp.com is a **658-page programmatic SEO engine**:

- **/integrations/[slug]** — 26 service landing pages with HowTo + FAQPage JSON-LD
- **/turn-it-on/[slug]** — 26 service hubs + 80+ capability pages
- **/glossary/[term]** — 80 AI term definition pages with DefinedTerm JSON-LD
- **/compare/[slug]** — 12 competitor comparison pages with Product JSON-LD
- **/forum** — Server-rendered community forum with DiscussionForumPosting JSON-LD
- **/u/[slug]** — Public user profiles with Person JSON-LD
- **/community** — Reddit-style discussion hub
- **/0n-standard** — Standard documentation
- **/builder** — Visual workflow builder
